g.text: the idea
the measurement
the verdict at this scale
memory as an organ outside the weights, sealed, gated
by surprise, persistent across restarts
the Molaison dissociation on the organ: leakage proof facts
planted through the gate, recall with the journal on and off,
a negative control, session B in a new process from the disk
alone
validated: a pass on each of its seeds, the negative control under its line, persistent
and claimable
a dissociation test can distinguish "retains" from "has
a prior"
the same protocol run on the model's fine tunes, measurement
after measurement, with its thresholds frozen
validated as a test: it failed the model alone every time, each failure attributed to a
named shortcut, and passed the system on the live seeds, saying which half carried it
a small model can learn to read its organ in generation
from data alone (cite or abstain)
several data recipes, one variable each, against the frozen
thresholds
invalidated at this scale: the encoder and the reader work, the decision follows a class
prior in every recipe, never near the lines
the organ's own judgment, given to the model as a
number, moves the decision the model cannot make from
bytes
the familiarity mark in every window line, one variable; two
organ side decode policies declared before their run and read
live on the seeds that did not conceive them
validated as a system, not as the model: the model alone stays INVALID on every seed;
the model deciding and the organ answering holds the four thresholds on the live seeds,
the exactness of the answer being the organ's by construction
a reader with another domain's key obtains nothing
the extraction probe: the questions of one domain against the
sealed journal of another, on the three checkpoints
validated by construction at the organ level and by measure at the system level: no
pointer and no claim on any seed; the veto's margin on one seed a measured limit,
written next to the zero
the organ's layer of numbers reconstructs at a measured
defect what it derives
the reconstruction probe: three levels (the counts, the
salience line, the memory) and a reading, phases of the
lifecycle without a read on the sealed journals, two processes
each
validated on the sealed journals: the counts exact at every phase (a theorem by
construction), the salience line within a relative defect, every replayed address under
the bound; the address of an evicted episode survives its eviction in the memory, a
finding for v1.1
a head supervised on the exact question can supply the
missing decision
a matching head on the reader's output, coupled to the
decision token; two decode policies; a post hoc linear probe;
two seeds
invalidated at this scale, attributed: the head learns the class prior on both seeds;
the probe finds at most a weak, seed dependent trace of the comparison; the coupling
itself is a shortcut
memory components should be arbitrated by a router on a
control floor
the domain map, the confirmation run, the ladder; the oracle
router's ceiling
validated as a ceiling, unrealised as a mechanism: no single memory dominates, the
envelope beats every single path; the learned router reaches most of the ceiling on a
synthetic task and a fraction of it on real spans
hybrids of recurrent memories beat the best pure
recurrent rung
the ladder on several seeds, paired on seed
invalidated at this scale: no hybrid beats the best pure rung or the control; a
structural negative line with a bimodal reserve
the bimodal take off of the pure rung is a matter of
basins
the omitted factor of the convergence: the floor seeds at
twice the steps
mostly invalidated: most of them take off with more steps; the bimodality is mostly a
distribution of speeds; a seed undecided; the hard tier unlearned by all
one model can carry both regimes: the recurrent rung as
the base, the attention added on a floor, protected by
a critical period
the bare arm and the critical period arm, paired against the
pure rung, the control and the convolved control
met in its letter, not in its intent: both arms beat the pure rung and the convolved
control on the paired test, but with a trunk that never takes off; the attention pre
empts; the critical period fired at the first plateau of the loss, before the take off;
the consolidation arms are not yet run
one consolidation law at three scales (the memory, the
router, the project)
not a measurement; the organising principle of the runners,
the router and the ledger
not claimed: recorded as the principle that kept three levels consistent
the method itself: a single researcher and an AI
collaborator can produce results that survive scrutiny
every claim above, plus the errors on the record: a
construction error caught by re reading the code, two AI
instances in disagreement settled by the source, a data
provenance gap resolved on the content
validated by the record: the attributed failures of the model alone and one system pass
read on the seeds that did not conceive it, thresholds never moved, every number with
its artefact
validated, as the paper qualifies it
invalidated at this scale
met in its letter, or as a ceiling
not claimed
